title: BL10 Desktop Game Audio Controller | BLUCALM Gaming
description: Mix game audio and team chat with BL10. Explore the hardware controls, Windows setup and specifications.
headline: Mix and balance audio from your game and voice chat apps instantly.

featuresHeading: Make the adjustment without leaving the game.

features.title: Game/Chat balance
features.text: Bring teammates forward or give game audio more room with the large dial.

features.title: Dedicated controls
features.text: Reach mic mute and Clutch Boost directly from the controller.

features.title: On-screen feedback
features.text: See the active sound mode and adjustments on the built-in display.

setup.heading: Set up Game/Chat.

steps.line: Connect BL10 to your PC over USB and plug your 3.5 mm headset into BL10.
Open Windows Volume Mixer and set your game output to BL Game.
Set your voice chat app output to BL Chat, then turn the dial to balance the two.
